name: hatsu
description: Hatsu is the local plane of the Akatsuki system: Kurapika leads it with six declared work-modes and a roster of focused independents, running on your own credentials with no GitHub App and no bot identity. Every deterministic step is a Nen verb, skills compose each other by name, and the five human gates are the maintainer's.

interface.shortDescription: The way of working: backlog, PRs, releases and QA driven to the human gate on Nen verbs
